# Hill-climb: what to build next, and what to build together

<!-- generated by control/scripts/tool-surface.mjs: do not edit; npm run tool-surface -->
Built from 6646ee89 on 1012-consolidate (2026-10-12). Sweep: 500 rolled worlds, seed 1, density 0.2.

Internal: for maintainers and their agents, not an MCP surface. A world is a cosmos cube (lib/graph/cosmos):
six facets of settings, each value built, local, partial or absent in the registry. A world is makeable when
every value it asks for is built. Effort: S = 1, M = 3, L = 8 (packages.js); "–" is unpriced: price it first.

## The loop

1. Pick from the three rankings below: a package that lifts many worlds per effort, a recipe many worlds wait on,
   or a pair with synergy (build the two as one concept).
2. Write its plan section and its Unreleased changelog entry; build it opt-in (absent keys keep every byte).
3. Mark the registry (status, lowers, godot) in lib/graph/cosmos/facets; a pair worth keeping becomes a package.
4. `npm run tool-surface`, read this page again, and note the move (verdict totals, the genre probes).

## The matrix

Every setting of every facet, its values by status. Statuses: built, local, partial, absent.

- **rung**: built: gen-6.0; absent: gen-6.5, gen-7.0, gen-7.5
